derivation: from a compound of G3844 (παρά) and G2698 (κατατίθημι);
def: something put down alongside, i.e. a deposit (sacred trust)

words.word: that which is committed to thy trust

occurrences.text: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
words: that which is committed to thy trust

occurrences.text: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
